llm_response.reason: The site displays numerous scam characteristics: it promotes a recognizable brand (Cinq à Sept) without verification or evidence of being an authorized retailer; company identity, business address, and relevant contact details are entirely absent (contact page has only a form and slogans); the privacy policy is generic with no details of legal/business registration; security and urgency language is used repeatedly but without substance; and there are detected SSL certificate issues. These attributes, along with the lack of evidence for legitimacy, match the criteria for a Fake Online Shopping scam.
